messages:
nidhi: Quick ask I'm getting two external visitors Thurs 10:30am. One courier said they'd drop a chunky wooden crate (art sample) at the lobby earlier. Can front desk accept art crates? Any special label we should ask for?

cal: Front desk can accept but for big/awkward stuff we prefer the crate tagged with recipient name + fragile. We usually move crates to the mailroom trolley and photo it in the system.

omar: If it's wood/crate-heavy ask courier to send a photo on arrival so we know if we need extra hands. We can also hold it on the lower rack.

frontdesk-bot: Delivery logged: carrier=CourierPro, ETA=Thu 09:15, size=crate, recipient=Nidhi. Recommended hold: mailroom trolley. Please ensure crate is labelled exactly: "Nidhi - Thu 10:30".

nidhi: Thanks I'll DM the courier for a photo and label. Are visitors allowed to pick it up from the lobby later or do we require sign-out?

mailroom-bot: Policy: non-postal items >30lbs require recipient sign-out at mailroom. We can note the guest names on the pickup log for that timeslot.

beech: Seating poll Where should the walkthrough be? React :one: for bench by window (monitor available), :two: for small conference (projector), :three: for lounge couch (casual).

cal: :one: Bench by window clean, good for product demos.

omar: :two: Conference projector might help with large art shots.

nidhi: leaning :two: we might want to show hi-res images on a bigger screen. If not used we'll fallback to bench.

frontdesk-bot: Note: temp visitor badges will print with blue stripe. Pre-register guests by 9:00am for express check-in.

nidhi: I'll pre-register names and ask courier for a photo. Thanks all! I'll ping when the crate arrives so mailroom can tag it. :raised_hands:
